changelog:
caniuse skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides browser compatibility queries for CSS/JS features via caniuse-cli.
- Includes detailed mapping of common feature names to caniuse queries.
- Offers installation guidance if caniuse-cli is missing.
- Explains how to present results and highlight key compatibility findings.
- Gives fallback instructions if a feature is not found in the database.
summary: Query browser compatibility for CSS/JS features using caniuse-cli. Use when user asks about browser support, compatibility, "can I use X", "does X work in IE...
